_meta.batch: Dirk CLUE X (~50 scen, 313 terminow) - reakcje Dirka na kazdy dowod w grze. Nowe elementy: nazwa 'Queen Serena' (statek z powiesci/filmu Wirmana - fikcjonalizowana wersja Dearest Seleny), watek autora recenzji ksiazki o tym samym imieniu co ktos znajomy (nieukonczony w tej partii - urwany dialog).
_meta.character_voice: Dirk: kontynuacja luznego, wspolczesnego slangu (batch_16-20, batch_50, batch_55).

Conversation/Dirk CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.en: I am [h]officially[/h] living the dream, how many people can say they're an action figure?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.pl: [h]Oficjalnie[/h] żyję marzeniem, ilu ludzi może powiedzieć, że są figurką akcji?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.en: You carry this thing around everywhere you go, Dirk?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.pl: Nosisz to ze sobą wszędzie, gdzie idziesz, Dirk?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.en: Of course - but I'm super duper careful to keep it in mint condition.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.pl: Jasne - ale bardzo, bardzo uważam, żeby utrzymać to w idealnym stanie.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.pl:
[i]Idealnym[/i] stanie...?
Ja bym raczej nie powiedziała-
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.en: Huh... do you have the whole set? Looks like there are [i]two[/i] other figures in the series?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.pl: Huh... masz cały zestaw? Wygląda na to, że są [i]dwie[/i] inne figurki z serii?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.en: Yeah, you know, they told me if I leave it in the box it'll be worth way more in the future.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.pl: Tak, no wiesz, powiedzieli mi, że jeśli zostawię ją w pudełku, będzie warta o wiele więcej w przyszłości.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.en: Oh, no, they only gave me this one. My co-star Julie has the other two.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.pl: Ach nie, dali mi tylko tę jedną. Moja partnerka z planu, Julie, ma te dwie pozostałe.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.en: Apparently Gripp ended up on the submarine because he crashed his balloon over the ocean?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.pl: Podobno Gripp trafił na łódź podwodną, bo rozbił swój balon nad oceanem?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.en: I mean, it's a great story, but...
Conversation/Dirk CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.pl: To znaczy, to świetna historia, ale...
Conversation/Dirk CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.en: Gripp's pretty smart, in fact, he might even be the smartest guy on the submarine.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.pl: Gripp jest całkiem bystry, właściwie, może być nawet najmądrzejszym gościem na łodzi podwodnej.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.en: ...I just don't see him crashing his balloon like that.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.pl: ...po prostu nie wyobrażam sobie, żeby rozbił balon w taki sposób.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.en: Maybe he just got caught in a storm.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.pl: Może po prostu złapał go sztorm.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.en: Oh yeah...  I didn't think about that.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.pl: A tak...  o tym nie pomyślałem.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE BlackBox/Section.en: Yeah, it has his vibes for sure.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE BlackBox/Section.pl: Tak, na pewno ma jego klimat.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE BlackBox/Section.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE BlackBox/Section.en: Oh, let me guess - it's locked and you can't work out how to open it?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE BlackBox/Section.pl: Och, niech zgadnę - jest zamknięta i nie możecie wykombinować, jak ją otworzyć?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE BlackBox/Section.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE BlackBox/Section.en: -okay but, for real, you [h]gotta[/h] let me know when you get it open cos now I'm [h]super[/h] curious.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE BlackBox/Section.pl: -okej, ale, na serio, [h]musicie[/h] mi powiedzieć, kiedy to otworzycie, bo teraz jestem [h]super[/h] ciekawy.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE BlackBox/Section.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.en: I know. That werewolf looking guy is really-
Conversation/Dirk CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.pl: Wiem. Ten koleś wyglądający jak wilkołak jest naprawdę-
Conversation/Dirk CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.en: She never told me about that! It's a strong look.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.pl: Nigdy mi o tym nie mówiła! To mocny wygląd.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE BrokenCompass/Sec.en: Gripp must have [i]really[/i] steady hands, working with all those small parts, huh? I could never.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE BrokenCompass/Sec.pl: Gripp musi mieć [i]naprawdę[/i] pewną rękę, pracując z tymi wszystkimi małymi częściami, co? Ja bym nigdy nie potrafił.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE BrokenCompass/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaptainsJacket/Se.en: Oh, yeah, I've seen that in the control room.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaptainsJacket/Se.pl: O, tak, widziałem to w sterowni.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaptainsJacket/Se.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaptainsJacket/Se.en: I thought maybe Sinthia was going to wear it? Like after she became captain?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaptainsJacket/Se.pl: Myślałem, że może Sinthia będzie to nosić? No wiesz, jak zostanie kapitanem?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaptainsJacket/Se.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaptainsJacket/Se.en: I think it might be too big for her.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaptainsJacket/Se.pl: Myślę, że może być na nią za duże.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaptainsJacket/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaptainsLog/Secti.en: He doesn't have a signature - Mortuga. He writes his name differently every time.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaptainsLog/Secti.pl: Nie ma podpisu - Mortuga. Za każdym razem pisze swoje imię inaczej.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaptainsLog/Secti.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaptainsLog/Secti.en:
Oh yeah.
I wonder if it's on purpose.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaptainsLog/Secti.pl:
A tak.
Ciekawe, czy to celowe.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaptainsLog/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaptainsLog/Secti.en: Maybe he just never bothered to decide on one.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaptainsLog/Secti.pl: Może po prostu nigdy nie zawracał sobie głowy ustaleniem jednego.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaptainsLog/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaptainsLog/Secti.en:
Right.
-doesn't seem like he was a... [i]paperwork[/i] kinda guy.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaptainsLog/Secti.pl:
No właśnie.
-nie wygląda na to, żeby był typem od... [i]papierkowej roboty.[/i]
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaptainsLog/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaretakersJournal.en: I'm pretty sure they don't sell this magazine at my local newstand.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaretakersJournal.pl: Jestem całkiem pewien, że nie sprzedają tego magazynu w moim lokalnym kiosku.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaretakersJournal.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaretakersJournal.en: ...I think it's more of a black market thing.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaretakersJournal.pl: ...myślę, że to raczej coś z czarnego rynku.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaretakersJournal.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaretakersJournal.en: Huh. Some of the listings in here, the prices are in [h]ounces[/h]... and there's a symbol?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaretakersJournal.pl: Huh. W niektórych ogłoszeniach tutaj ceny są w [h]uncjach...[/h] i jest jakiś symbol?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaretakersJournal.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaretakersJournal.en: It's the alchemical symbol for gold.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaretakersJournal.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaretakersJournal.en: Man, is Zephyr like secretly [h]super rich?[/h]
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaretakersJournal.pl: Stary, czy Zephyr jest jakoś w tajemnicy [h]super bogaty?[/h]
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaretakersJournal.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaseFile/Section.en: So - Sinthia hired you to solve the murder, huh?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaseFile/Section.pl: Więc - Sinthia was wynajęła, żeby rozwiązać morderstwo, tak?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaseFile/Section.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaseFile/Section.en: How much do you charge? Is it like a day rate, or - what?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaseFile/Section.pl: Ile bierzecie? To jakaś stawka dzienna, czy - co?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaseFile/Section.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaseFile/Section.en: Oh, uh - it, uh - you know it - it depends.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaseFile/Section.pl: Och, yy - to, yy - no wiesz - to zależy.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaseFile/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaseFile/Section.en: -just ballpark it, how much did you make from the last case you solved?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaseFile/Section.pl: -po prostu w przybliżeniu, ile zarobiliście na ostatniej rozwiązanej sprawie?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaseFile/Section.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaseFile/Section.en: [h]Good question.[/h] Grimoire, how much [h]did[/h] we make from the Tangle Tower case?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaseFile/Section.pl: [h]Dobre pytanie.[/h] Grimoire, ile [h]zarobiliśmy[/h] na sprawie Tangle Tower?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaseFile/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaseFile/Section.en: You never secured the payment, huh?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CaseFile/Section.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CellPhone/Section.en: We literally found it in the pocket of your tuxedo.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CellPhone/Section.pl: Dosłownie znaleźliśmy to w kieszeni twojego smokingu.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CellPhone/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CellPhone/Section.en: How d'you know for sure it's [i]my[/i] tuxedo?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CellPhone/Section.pl: Skąd wiecie na pewno, że to [i]mój[/i] smoking?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CellPhone/Section.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CellPhone/Section.en: Dirk. Show me one other living soul on this submarine that could even [h]conceivably[/h] own a tuxedo.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CellPhone/Section.pl: Dirk. Pokaż mi jedną inną żywą duszę na tej łodzi podwodnej, która [h]w ogóle mogłaby[/h] mieć smoking.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CellPhone/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CommandContract/S.en: No... I don't like this at [h]all...[/h]
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CommandContract/S.pl: Nie... [h]zupełnie[/h] mi się to nie podoba...
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CommandContract/S.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CommandContract/S.en:
Why not?
You think she misread it?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CommandContract/S.pl:
Czemu nie?
Myślisz, że źle to odczytała?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CommandContract/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CommandContract/S.en: Or what - Mortuga forced her to sign it?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CommandContract/S.pl: Albo co - Mortuga zmusił ją, żeby to podpisała?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CommandContract/S.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CommandContract/S.en: I don't really see the problem. Sinthia wanted to be captain, and now she's captain.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CommandContract/S.pl: Nie widzę tu problemu. Sinthia chciała być kapitanem, i teraz jest kapitanem.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CommandContract/S.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CommandContract/S.en: Whoa, wait - [h]this[/h] is the contract Sinthia signed to become captain??
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CommandContract/S.pl: Whoa, czekajcie - [h]to[/h] jest kontrakt, który Sinthia podpisała, żeby zostać kapitanem??
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CommandContract/S.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CommandContract/S.en:
Seems that way.
What's the problem?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CommandContract/S.pl:
Wygląda na to.
O co chodzi?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CommandContract/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.en: Man... Mortuga really was an odd duck, wasn't he?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.pl: Stary... Mortuga naprawdę był dziwakiem, co nie?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.en: I mean, who [i]owns[/i] something like this?? What's it even [i]for?[/i]
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.pl: To znaczy, kto [i]posiada[/i] coś takiego?? Do czego to w ogóle [i]służy?[/i]
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.en: It used to be locked, so I think he kept something inside it.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.pl: Kiedyś było zamknięte, więc myślę, że trzymał tam coś w środku.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.en: Oh, what - and it got [h]stolen?[/h] The thing - whatever it was?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.pl: O, co - i to zostało [h]skradzione?[/h] Ta rzecz - czymkolwiek była?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.en: Whoa... I wonder where it is now??
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.pl: Whoa... ciekawe, gdzie to teraz jest??
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.en: Hard to say, since we don't know what we're looking for. But - [h]somewhere[/h] on the submarine, I guess.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.pl: Trudno powiedzieć, skoro nie wiemy, czego szukamy. Ale - [h]gdzieś[/h] na łodzi podwodnej, zgaduję.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.en: Not neccessarily, someone could've thrown it into the ocean!
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.pl: Niekoniecznie, ktoś mógł to wyrzucić do oceanu!
Conversation/Dirk CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE DivingLicense/Sec.en: Hey, wow. Uh, did Tadpole give you that?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE DivingLicense/Sec.pl: Hej, wow. Yy, Tadpole ci to dała?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE DivingLicense/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE DivingLicense/Sec.en: No, we found it in the bilge. You think it belongs to her?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE DivingLicense/Sec.pl: Nie, znaleźliśmy to w zęzie. Myślisz, że to należy do niej?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE DivingLicense/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE DivingLicense/Sec.en: Nah, it's [h]gotta[/h] be hers, you're right about the photo, though - her hair is brown, here...
Conversation/Dirk CLUE DivingLicense/Sec.pl: Nie, to [h]musi[/h] być jej, chociaż masz rację co do zdjęcia - tutaj ma brązowe włosy...
Conversation/Dirk CLUE DivingLicense/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE DivingLicense/Sec.en:
It would make sense...
Although the woman in the photo looks a [i]little[/i] different.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE DivingLicense/Sec.pl:
Miałoby to sens...
Chociaż kobieta na zdjęciu wygląda [i]trochę[/i] inaczej.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE DivingLicense/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE DivingLicense/Sec.en: I guess she dyes it green nowadays?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE DivingLicense/Sec.pl: Zgaduję, że teraz farbuje je na zielono?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE DivingLicense/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE DreamHelmet/Secti.en: Dr Z told me this is a [i]'Dream Helmet'?[/i]
Conversation/Dirk CLUE DreamHelmet/Secti.pl: Doktor Z powiedział mi, że to [i]'Hełm Snów'?[/i]
Conversation/Dirk CLUE DreamHelmet/Secti.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE DreamHelmet/Secti.en: No time, bro, gotta optimize that sleep cycle, you know - [i]if you're dreaming, you're not resting.[/i]
Conversation/Dirk CLUE DreamHelmet/Secti.pl: Nie ma czasu, stary, trzeba zoptymalizować cykl snu, no wiesz - [i]jak śnisz, to nie odpoczywasz.[/i]
Conversation/Dirk CLUE DreamHelmet/Secti.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE DriftwoodCane/Sec.en:
What's not to get?
It's a cane with a face!
Conversation/Dirk CLUE DriftwoodCane/Sec.pl:
Co tu nie rozumieć?
To laska z twarzą!
Conversation/Dirk CLUE DriftwoodCane/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE DriftwoodCane/Sec.en: Okay, so - for real, Gripp's actually, like, [h]super[/h] smart.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE DriftwoodCane/Sec.pl: Okej, więc - na serio, Gripp jest tak naprawdę, no wiesz, [h]super[/h] mądry.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE DriftwoodCane/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE DriftwoodCane/Sec.en: [i]W-why?[/i] Why bother with the - the cane, and the whole persona?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE DriftwoodCane/Sec.pl: [i]C-czemu?[/i] Po co zawracać sobie głowę - laską i całą tą personą?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE DriftwoodCane/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE DriftwoodCane/Sec.en: See - this is my point! He [h]hides[/h] it!
Conversation/Dirk CLUE DriftwoodCane/Sec.pl: No właśnie - o to mi chodzi! On to [h]ukrywa![/h]
Conversation/Dirk CLUE DriftwoodCane/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.en: It... could do with a bit of [i]ageing[/i], though.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.en: Well, it's pristine, but - stuff like that doesn't look so hot when it's brand new.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.pl: No, jest nieskazitelna, ale - takie rzeczy nie wyglądają zbyt dobrze, kiedy są nowiuteńkie.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.en: On our [i]movie[/i], we had a guy who roughed up all the outfits, made them look [i]lived-in[/i], you know.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.pl: Przy naszym [i]filmie[/i] mieliśmy gościa, który przecierał wszystkie stroje, żeby wyglądały [i]znoszone,[/i] no wiesz.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.en: So this photo is the first time Sinthia's mom wore that jacket?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.pl: Więc na tym zdjęciu mama Sinthii nosi tę marynarkę po raz pierwszy?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE FeliciaPainting/S.en: Uh... I don't think so, she-
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FeliciaPainting/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE FeliciaPainting/S.en: [h]Of course[/h] he'd land a girl like this. [h]Of course![/h]
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FeliciaPainting/S.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE FeliciaPainting/S.en: ...I dunno, wasn't he kind of a gloomy loner?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FeliciaPainting/S.pl: ...nie wiem, czy nie był takim ponurym samotnikiem?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FeliciaPainting/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.en: Dirk, you're a [i]movie[/i] kinda guy - is this your projector?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.pl: Dirk, jesteś typem od [i]filmów[/i] - to twój projektor?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.en: Yup. I thought I'd lost it! I guess I [i]did[/i], huh.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.pl: Ta. Myślałem, że ją zgubiłem! Zgaduję, że [i]jednak[/i] tak, co.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.en: Oh, it's just like, um - a bit of a scene... a [i]daily[/i], you know.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.pl: Och, to tylko, no, yy - fragment sceny... [i]dzienny materiał,[/i] no wiesz.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.en: It was a gift from the studio - lil' souvenir.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.pl: To był prezent od wytwórni - mała pamiątka.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.en: I dunno, Mess Hall, probably? Where did you [i]find[/i] it?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.pl: Nie wiem, w Mesie, pewnie? Gdzie to [i]znaleźliście?[/i]
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.en: It was in the hollowed out stomach of a do-
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.en:
It was in a cabinet.
Normal - cabinet.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.en: So, uh... can I have it back?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE FogBall/Section d.en: Right - but - a crystal ball in the sense that it's a magic ball you look into and see your future or whatever?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FogBall/Section d.pl: No dobra - ale - kryształowa kula w sensie, że to magiczna kula, do której zaglądasz i widzisz swoją przyszłość czy coś?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FogBall/Section d.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE FogBall/Section d.en: Why don't [h]you[/h] look into it - you'll see yourself solving the murder - and then you'll know who did it.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FogBall/Section d.pl: Czemu [h]ty[/h] tam nie zajrzysz - zobaczysz siebie, jak rozwiązujesz morderstwo - i wtedy będziesz wiedział, kto to zrobił.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE FogBall/Section d.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE GlassEyeball/Sect.en: So maybe try asking Mariana about it, she's got a [i]wicked[/i] sense of smell - like a [i]dog.[/i]
Conversation/Dirk CLUE GlassEyeball/Sect.pl: No to może spróbuj zapytać o to Marianę, ma [i]niesamowity[/i] węch - jak [i]pies.[/i]
Conversation/Dirk CLUE GlassEyeball/Sect.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE GoldenLocket/Sect.en: Hey! It's Sym's necklace locket thing.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE GoldenLocket/Sect.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE GoldenLocket/Sect.en: Any idea what she keeps in there?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE GoldenLocket/Sect.pl: Masz pojęcie, co ona tam trzyma?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE GoldenLocket/Sect.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE GoldenLocket/Sect.pl: To tak naprawdę nie moja sprawa.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE GoldenLocket/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE GoldenLocket/Sect.en: Unless you decide it's related to the [i]murder[/i]. Then you'd be all over it, I bet.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE GoldenLocket/Sect.pl: Chyba że uznasz, że jest związane z [i]morderstwem.[/i] Wtedy założę się, że wgryzłbyś się w to.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE GoldenLocket/Sect.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandheldRadio/Sec.en: ...a radio? What's the range on that thing?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandheldRadio/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandheldRadio/Sec.en: No idea. I'm pretty sure it's broken anyway.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandheldRadio/Sec.pl: Nie mam pojęcia. Jestem całkiem pewien, że i tak jest zepsute.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandheldRadio/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandheldRadio/Sec.en: It might get a better signal up in the control room, or up on deck.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandheldRadio/Sec.pl: Może mieć lepszy sygnał w sterowni, albo na pokładzie.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandheldRadio/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandheldRadio/Sec.en: Down here you get nothing - the walls are way too thick.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandheldRadio/Sec.pl: Tu na dole nic nie łapiesz - ściany są o wiele za grube.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandheldRadio/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandwrittenLetter.en: Oh, hey, you found Wirman's letter.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandwrittenLetter.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandwrittenLetter.en: Uh, no - generally speaking you [i]do not[/i] read another dude's fanmail.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandwrittenLetter.pl: Yy, nie - ogólnie rzecz biorąc [i]nie czyta się[/i] czyjejś poczty od fanów.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandwrittenLetter.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandwrittenLetter.en: What makes you think it's fanmail?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandwrittenLetter.pl: Czemu myślisz, że to poczta od fana?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandwrittenLetter.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandwrittenLetter.en: Wirman read that thing a [h]hundred[/h] times over on the journey down here.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandwrittenLetter.pl: Wirman przeczytał to ze [h]sto[/h] razy w drodze tutaj.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandwrittenLetter.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandwrittenLetter.en: I just figured... must be something nice, you know?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandwrittenLetter.pl: Po prostu pomyślałem... to musi być coś miłego, no wiesz?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HandwrittenLetter.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexBottle/Section.en: Hey, so - remind me what a [i]Hex[/i] is again?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexBottle/Section.pl: Hej, więc - przypomnij mi, czym jest [i]Hex?[/i]
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexBottle/Section.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexBottle/Section.en:
It's... not a made up word.
A Hex is a magic spell - kinda like a curse.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexBottle/Section.pl:
To... nie zmyślone słowo.
Hex to magiczne zaklęcie - coś jak klątwa.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexBottle/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexBottle/Section.en: Or it can mean [i]six[/i] - as in hexagon.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexBottle/Section.pl: Albo może oznaczać [i]sześć[/i] - jak w heksagonie.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexBottle/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexBottle/Section.en: I... I was hoping that would clear up what a [i]Hex Bottle[/i] was, but no dice.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexBottle/Section.pl: Ja... miałem nadzieję, że to wyjaśni, czym jest [i]Butelka Hexa,[/i] ale nic z tego.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexBottle/Section.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexBottle/Section.en: Didn't you [h]just[/h] make a movie called [i]'Hex of the Helmsman'[/i]??
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexBottle/Section.pl: Czy nie nakręciłeś [h]właśnie[/h] filmu pod tytułem [i]'Klątwa Sternika'?![/i]
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexBottle/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexBottle/Section.en: Right, right, but - look - I'm bad with learning what the made up words mean.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexBottle/Section.pl: No tak, tak, ale - słuchaj - jestem słaby w zapamiętywaniu, co znaczą zmyślone słowa.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexBottle/Section.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.en:
Whoa, this is a first [h]edish!![/h]
Who's [h]is[/h] this?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.en: You gonna get Wirmo to sign it?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.en: No... I hadn't planned on it.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.en: He'd do it if you asked! I bet he'd even do a little [i]doodle[/i] on the inside cover.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.pl: Zrobiłby to, gdybyś poprosiła! Założę się, że narysowałby nawet mały [i]bazgroł[/i] na wewnętrznej okładce.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.en: I assume you've read it, Dirk?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.en: Of course, dude - first thing I did when I landed the part in the movie.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.pl: Jasne, stary - pierwsza rzecz, którą zrobiłem, kiedy dostałem tę rolę w filmie.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.en: Loved it. I'd never thought about the sea so much in my whole life.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.pl: Uwielbiałem. Nigdy w życiu tyle nie myślałem o morzu.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.en: It's almost like... the ocean in the book... it represents something... bigger, you know?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.pl: To prawie jakby... ocean w tej książce... reprezentował coś... większego, no wiesz?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE IllusionistPoster.en: Huh. Who's that little grim reaper guy in the drawing?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE IllusionistPoster.pl: Huh. Kim jest ten mały koleś-kostucha na rysunku?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE IllusionistPoster.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE IllusionistPoster.en: I'm not sure. You recognise it?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE IllusionistPoster.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE IllusionistPoster.en: It does seem kinda familiar, for - some reason?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE IllusionistPoster.pl: Wygląda jakoś znajomo, z jakiegoś... powodu?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE IllusionistPoster.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE InnDeeds/Section.en: I'd be surprised if it hasn't expired by now...
Conversation/Dirk CLUE InnDeeds/Section.pl: Byłbym zaskoczony, gdyby do tej pory nie stracił ważności...
Conversation/Dirk CLUE InnDeeds/Section.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE InnDeeds/Section.en: Yeah, things like this normally have an agreed upon-
Conversation/Dirk CLUE InnDeeds/Section.pl: Tak, takie rzeczy zazwyczaj mają uzgodniony-
Conversation/Dirk CLUE InnDeeds/Section.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE InnDeeds/Section.en: Huh. I guess it runs in perpetuity.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE InnDeeds/Section.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE InnDeeds/Section.en: What about if you ripped it in half?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE InnDeeds/Section.pl: A co, gdybyś podarł go na pół?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE InnDeeds/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE InnDeeds/Section.en: Ha, you know what - I found that doesn't actually do jack?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE InnDeeds/Section.pl: Ha, wiesz co - okazało się, że to wcale nic nie daje?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE InnDeeds/Section.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE InnDeeds/Section.en: No, I know - it works in the movies, but in real life, voiding a contract is a more [i]complex procedure.[/i]
Conversation/Dirk CLUE InnDeeds/Section.pl: Nie, wiem - w filmach to działa, ale w prawdziwym życiu unieważnienie kontraktu to bardziej [i]skomplikowana procedura.[/i]
Conversation/Dirk CLUE InnDeeds/Section.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE IronBell/Section.en: I thought it was a bell.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE IronBell/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE IronBell/Section.en: Only it doesn't actually ring, so... not really a bell, but-
Conversation/Dirk CLUE IronBell/Section.pl: Tylko że tak naprawdę nie dzwoni, więc... nie do końca dzwon, ale-
Conversation/Dirk CLUE IronBell/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE IronBell/Section.en: Nah I think it's some kinda... [i]mechanism.[/i]
Conversation/Dirk CLUE IronBell/Section.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE IronBell/Section.en: The bit sticking out the bottom looks a bit like a screwdriver. Don't you think?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE IronBell/Section.pl: Ta część wystająca z dołu wygląda trochę jak śrubokręt. Nie sądzicie?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE IronBell/Section.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE LifesizeDoll/Sect.en: Hey, I didn't know Sym had a stunt dummy.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE LifesizeDoll/Sect.pl: Hej, nie wiedziałem, że Sym ma manekina kaskaderskiego.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE LifesizeDoll/Sect.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE LifesizeDoll/Sect.en: She planning to do a scene where she falls off a cliff into a crocodile-infested river?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE LifesizeDoll/Sect.pl: Planuje nakręcić scenę, w której spada z klifu do rzeki pełnej krokodyli?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE LifesizeDoll/Sect.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE LifesizeDoll/Sect.en: When the stunt is that dangerous, and the stunt guy refuses to do it - you use the dummy.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE LifesizeDoll/Sect.pl: Kiedy kaskaderka jest tak niebezpieczna, a kaskader odmawia jej zrobienia - używasz manekina.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE LifesizeDoll/Sect.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE MermaidPainting/S.en:
[h]'HER.'[/h]
Ha. Deliberately vague title. Love it.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE MermaidPainting/S.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE MessageinaBottle/.en: Yeah, that's one of my non-alcoholic beers.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE MessageinaBottle/.pl: Tak, to jedno z moich bezalkoholowych piw.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE MessageinaBottle/.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE MessageinaBottle/.en: Course, someone's waxed up the top and put a whole bunch of green stuff on the bottom...
Conversation/Dirk CLUE MessageinaBottle/.pl: Jasne, ktoś zalał wierzch woskiem i wsadził na dno całą masę zielonych rzeczy...
Conversation/Dirk CLUE MessageinaBottle/.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE ModelTown/Section.en: Do you recognise any of the buildings?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ModelTown/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE ModelTown/Section.en: Oh - is it supposed to be something specific??
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ModelTown/Section.pl: O - to ma przedstawiać coś konkretnego??
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ModelTown/Section.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE ModelTown/Section.en: I thought it was just, like, you know - [i]toytown[/i] or whatever.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ModelTown/Section.pl: Myślałem, że to po prostu, no wiesz - jakieś [i]miasteczko-zabawka[/i] czy coś.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ModelTown/Section.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.en: I assume this is yours, Dirk.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.en: Yeah - I let the kids borrow it, since there weren't a lot of other magazines on board...
Conversation/Dirk CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.pl: Tak - pożyczyłem to dzieciakom, bo nie było wielu innych magazynów na pokładzie...
Conversation/Dirk CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.en: I noticed on the back - there's an advert for your movie.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.pl: Zauważyłem z tyłu - jest reklama twojego filmu.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.en: Yup. That's me on the left, all dolled up as Markus Mordoom, the [i]titular[/i] helmsman.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.pl: Ta. To ja po lewej, wystrojony za Markusa Mordooma, [i]tytułowego[/i] sternika.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.en: Right, you're the title character, but, there's uh - only one name at the top.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.pl: No tak, jesteś tytułową postacią, ale, jest, yy - tylko jedno imię na górze.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.en: Uh - Julie was already a big name, so... you know, she got her name on the poster.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.pl: Yy - Julie była już wielką nazwą, więc... no wiesz, jej imię trafiło na plakat.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.en: ...well, I'm sure when they make the sequel, Dirk's name will be front and centre.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.pl: ...cóż, jestem pewien, że kiedy zrobią kontynuację, imię Dirka będzie na samym środku.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.en: And they spelled your name wrong.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.en: Are we done looking at the magazine?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE NewspaperPage/Sec.en: Hey, the guy who wrote this review has the same name as...
Conversation/Dirk CLUE NewspaperPage/Sec.pl: Hej, koleś, który napisał tę recenzję, ma takie samo imię jak...
Conversation/Dirk CLUE NewspaperPage/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE NewspaperPage/Sec.en: I'm - I'm not sure if I'm allowed to say.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE NewspaperPage/Sec.pl: Ja - nie jestem pewien, czy mogę powiedzieć.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE NewspaperPage/Sec.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE Pocketbook/Sectio.en: Oh, a combination lock - let me try...
Conversation/Dirk CLUE Pocketbook/Sectio.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE Pocketbook/Sectio.en: How did you know the code?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE Pocketbook/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE Pocketbook/Sectio.en: It belongs to Madam Tadpole, but it's locked.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE Pocketbook/Sectio.pl: To należy do Madam Tadpole, ale jest zamknięte.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE Pocketbook/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE RaggedCloth/Secti.en: What's the deal with those holes along the sides?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE RaggedCloth/Secti.pl: O co chodzi z tymi dziurami po bokach?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE RaggedCloth/Secti.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE RaggedCloth/Secti.en: They're from when it was a sail.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE RaggedCloth/Secti.pl: Są z czasów, kiedy to był żagiel.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE RaggedCloth/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE RaggedCloth/Secti.en: Why would a submarine need a sail??
Conversation/Dirk CLUE RaggedCloth/Secti.pl: Po co łodzi podwodnej potrzebny żagiel??
Conversation/Dirk CLUE RaggedCloth/Secti.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE SeaChart/Section.en: Dude, there's a big red X. You gotta assume that's a treasure.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE SeaChart/Section.pl: Stary, jest wielki czerwony X. Musicie założyć, że to skarb.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE SeaChart/Section.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE SeaChart/Section.en: A big chest of gold doubloons, you think?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE SeaChart/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE SeaChart/Section.en: -It doesn't specifically [h]say[/h] it's a treasure map.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE SeaChart/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE SeaChart/Section.en: Although, thinking about it, d'you think anywhere still takes doubloons?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE SeaChart/Section.pl: Chociaż, jak się nad tym zastanowić, myślicie, że ktokolwiek jeszcze przyjmuje dublony?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE SeaChart/Section.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.en: No - that's the name of the ship in the [h]novel.[/h] And in Dirk's movie, too. I'm guessing.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.pl: Nie - tak nazywa się statek w [h]powieści.[/h] I w filmie Dirka też, jak zgaduję.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE ShipsWheel/Sectio.en: I got to steer a big wheel like this in my movie.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ShipsWheel/Sectio.pl: W moim filmie mogłem sterować takim wielkim kołem.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ShipsWheel/Sectio.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE ShipsWheel/Sectio.en: Mine didn't have that red metal bit, though.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ShipsWheel/Sectio.pl: Moje nie miało jednak tej czerwonej metalowej części.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ShipsWheel/Sectio.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE ShipsWheel/Sectio.en: Also mine was up on the aft deck, not, you know, indoors in a control room.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ShipsWheel/Sectio.pl: Poza tym moje było na pokładzie rufowym, nie, no wiesz, w środku, w sterowni.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE ShipsWheel/Sectio.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.en: I don't know much about the town, you'd be better off asking someone else.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.pl: Nie wiem wiele o miasteczku, lepiej zapytajcie kogoś innego.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE StrangeDevice/Sec.en: You know what this is, Dirk?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE StrangeDevice/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE StrangeDevice/Sec.en: Well, whatever it is, I think it's broken.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE StrangeDevice/Sec.pl: Cóż, czymkolwiek jest, myślę, że jest zepsute.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE StrangeDevice/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE SubmarineBlueprin.en: I'm glad Sinthia took my advice.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE SubmarineBlueprin.pl: Cieszę się, że Sinthia posłuchała mojej rady.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE SubmarineBlueprin.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE SubmarineBlueprin.en: She was looking super tense, so I told her to pick up a hobby. Arts and crafts is a good choice.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE SubmarineBlueprin.pl: Wyglądała na super spiętą, więc powiedziałem jej, żeby znalazła sobie hobby. Rękodzieło to dobry wybór.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE SubmarineBlueprin.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.en: That's the one you get from sunlight?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.pl: To ta, którą dostaje się od światła słonecznego?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.en: How come you left them in the mess hall?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Dirk CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.en: I figured the others might benefit from them...
Conversation/Dirk CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.pl: Pomyślałem, że innym też się przydadzą...
Conversation/Dirk CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.en: Not sure I had any takers, though.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.pl: Chociaż nie jestem pewien, czy ktoś skorzystał.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.en: I [h]gotta[/h] take it while I'm down here - since I'm not getting natural light, you know...
Conversation/Dirk CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.pl: [h]Muszę[/h] je brać, póki tu jestem na dole - skoro nie mam naturalnego światła, no wiesz...
Conversation/Dirk CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE Typewriter/Sectio.en: Wirmo's typewriter - he lugged it all the way here.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE Typewriter/Sectio.pl: Maszyna do pisania Wirma - przywlókł ją aż tutaj.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE Typewriter/Sectio.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE Typewriter/Sectio.en: I tried to tell him about modern alternatives, but he wouldn't hear it.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE Typewriter/Sectio.pl: Próbowałem mu opowiedzieć o nowoczesnych alternatywach, ale nie chciał słuchać.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE Typewriter/Sectio.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE Typewriter/Sectio.en: Why d'you think he insists on using it?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE Typewriter/Sectio.pl: Czemu, twoim zdaniem, upiera się, żeby jej używać?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE Typewriter/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE Typewriter/Sectio.en: Other than the fact that he's a big ol' poser?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE Typewriter/Sectio.pl: Poza tym, że jest wielkim pozerem?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE Typewriter/Sectio.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE Typewriter/Sectio.en: I mean, probably because it used to belong to his Dad.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE Typewriter/Sectio.pl: To znaczy, pewnie dlatego, że kiedyś należała do jego taty.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE Typewriter/Sectio.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE UnderwaterPhoto/S.en: I don't know what that is - it's making me nervous, though.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE UnderwaterPhoto/S.pl: Nie wiem, co to jest - ale to mnie denerwuje.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE UnderwaterPhoto/S.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE UnderwaterPhoto/S.en: Can we talk about something else?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE UnderwaterPhoto/S.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sectio.en: I've seen this chained up on the fore deck, it's kind of intimidating, huh?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sectio.pl: Widziałem to przykute na pokładzie dziobowym, trochę onieśmielające, co?
Conversation/Dirk CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sectio.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sectio.en: Huh. It has long hair, so I always figured it was a girl.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sectio.pl: Huh. Ma długie włosy, więc zawsze myślałem, że to dziewczyna.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sectio.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Dirk CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.en: Maybe she ran out of pipeweed.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.pl: Może skończył jej się tytoń fajkowy.
Conversation/Dirk CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.en: What?? It's another word for tobacco!
Conversation/Dirk CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.pl: Co?? To po prostu inne słowo na tytoń!
Conversation/Dirk CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Dirk CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.en: Huh. I've never actually seen her [h]smoke[/h] that thing...
Conversation/Dirk CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.pl: Huh. Właściwie nigdy nie widziałem, żeby [h]paliła[/h] to coś...
Conversation/Dirk CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.speaker: Dirk

do_pozniejszej_weryfikacji.term: Dirk CLUE NewspaperPage - urwany dialog o autorze recenzji
do_pozniejszej_weryfikacji.problem: Dialog o tym, ze autor recenzji ma takie samo imie jak ktos znajomy, urywa sie bez odpowiedzi (ds16 konczy sie '...jak, yy...' bez dokonczenia) - podobnie jak w zrodle (brak dalszych kluczy w tej scenie). Watek pozostaje niewyjasniony - mozliwe ze to nawiazanie do watku T. W. Ibisa (batch_39) lub Mayor Damian Dusk/ojca Wirmana (batch_60) - do sledzenia.

Nowa nazwa fikcyjnego statku z powiesci/filmu Wirmana ('Queen Serena') - fikcjonalizowana wersja prawdziwego statku 'Dearest Selena'. Zostawiono bez tlumaczenia jak inne nazwy wlasne statkow w projekcie - do potwierdzenia spojnosci przy tlumaczeniu kolejnych partii dotyczacych ksiazki Wirmana.
